name: stata-workbench-shared-session
description: A patched Stata Workbench distribution focused on visible human-agent shared sessions, resilient lifecycle recovery, and graph-panel routing. Cross-platform support is validated per release notes; do not assume dual-OS certification from the package description alone.
author: LZHS and contributors

stataMcp.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Stata metadata and UI requests.

stataMcp.enableExecuteTimeout.description: Enable timeout for Stata execution commands. Disabled by default for long-running research scripts.

stataMcp.loadStataOnStartup.description: Load Stata automatically when VS Code starts.

stataMcp.autoRevealOutput.description: Automatically show the Stata output channel after runs.

stataMcp.showAllLogsInOutput.description: Stream all raw mcp-stata logs to the Stata Workbench Output channel.

stataMcp.logStataCode.description: Log Stata code sent to the backend.

stataMcp.autoConfigureMcp.description: Automatically add or update mcp-stata in host MCP config.

stataMcp.runFileWorkingDirectory.description: Working directory for running .do files. Supports absolute paths, ~, ${workspaceFolder}, and ${fileDir}.

stataMcp.maxOutputLines.description: Maximum output lines shown in the Stata Terminal webview.

stataMcp.stataPath.description: Path to the local Stata executable.

stataMcp.restoreFinalSnapshotAfterGraphR.description: Restore final in-do dataset snapshot after human Run File graph routing. Default false. Only the strict boolean true enables restore (fail-closed on config errors). Optional kill-switch: globalThis.__codexDisableHumanFileSnapshotRestore.

stataMcp.visibleBridgePort.description: HTTP bridge listen port for /status, /run-command, and /soft-stop (default 17485). Use 17495 for independent cold-install profile so production 17485 is undisturbed. Invalid or bind failure fails closed with an error.
